start: Owner of a real, online gym that has paid MettleUp; Settings → Pay MettleUp → 'Your receipts'

Button 'Back to Pay MettleUp'
'Loading…' for a moment

A period that does not match the plan bought
An empty legal name line

user_sees: The browser's print box, showing only the receipt
must_not: The page header, the menu or the button printed on the paper
A dark background on the paper
